newsitem.title: UK: Morgan Stanley adds 30 mln marks to Apr 2014 bond. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley adds 30 mln marks to Apr 2014 bond. [CORRECTED 17:40 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear bond was increased by 30 million marks to 130 million marks and not by 130 million marks. Also changes maturity date from 2012 to 2014.)
The following bond has been increased by 30 million marks to 130 million marks, lead manager Morgan Stanley said on Monday.
